source.title: Fundamental limits for thermodynamic control with quantum feedback

hypothesis: A source-exact, independently reproduced quantum-feedback work-bound model can expose missing controller-side information resources in future UQPU workload accounting; it does not by itself predict lower wall-plug energy or lower cost.
incumbent_assumption_to_audit: Quantum side information may be treated as if it were a free classical controller record or omitted from the system boundary.
proposed_alternative: Use the source theorem's single-shot work bounds and asymptotic conditional-free-energy result while explicitly declaring side-information acquisition, preparation, retention, processing, transfer, measurement and reset/disposal resources.
method: Transcribe exact theorem and assumptions from the public manuscript; do not infer equations from the abstract.
Freeze matched finite-dimensional quantum-side-information, classical/dephased-record and no-side-information fixtures.
Independently implement the single-shot work-of-formation and extractable-work bounds and the asymptotic limit.
Test held-out parameter combinations, source-consistent limiting cases and independent algebraic/numerical checks.
Fail closed if resource fields are missing or system boundaries differ.
Keep thermodynamic work, wall-plug energy, provider charges and cost per accepted useful task as separate quantities.

integration_edges.hypothesis: explicit controller-side information resources reduce hidden-boundary accounting errors
integration_edges.falsifier: independent implementation disagrees with the source theorem or the result changes only because the comparison boundary changes

integration_edges.interface: state, memory, transfer and output-information contract
integration_edges.hypothesis: side information and its readout/retention are explicit resources rather than readable classical storage by assumption
integration_edges.falsifier: the resource ledger cannot identify required classical output, state retention and data movement separately

integration_edges.hypothesis: future execution records can bind state-transition quality to the same target's calibration, price, control and I/O
integration_edges.falsifier: cross-target or cross-provider quantities are mixed, or no accepted useful output is measured

integration_edges.interface: validated control/memory requirement to device/factory requirements
integration_edges.hypothesis: only after a validated algorithmic requirement, control/retention needs can inform device and manufacturing design
integration_edges.falsifier: device requirements are inferred from literature alone without a validated workload

integration_edges.hypothesis: resource-boundary discipline can be reused for bio-oil, fusion and financing ledgers without transferring quantum-work claims to those domains
integration_edges.falsifier: coproduct credits, net-electricity boundaries or financing effects are double-counted or asserted without evidence
